forum.kind_count_discussion: {count, plural, one {# discussion started} other {# discussions started}}
forum.kind_count_like: {count, plural, one {# like given} other {# likes given}}
forum.kind_count_best_answer: {count, plural, one {# best answer} other {# best answers}}
forum.count_on: {count, plural, one {# thing on {date}} other {# things on {date}}}
forum.spark_label: {count, plural, one {# thing in the last 26 weeks} other {# things in the last 26 weeks}}
forum.at_least: {count, plural, one {# or more} other {# or more}}

admin.show_on_profile: Show the map on member profiles
admin.show_on_profile_help: The full map, on every profile. This is the one most forums want.
admin.show_on_posts: Show a sparkline beside every post
admin.show_on_posts_help: A small twenty-six week trace next to each author. Costs one extra query per distinct member on a page — not per post — so it is cheap, but it is off unless you ask for it.
admin.show_on_cards: Show a sparkline on user cards
admin.show_on_cards_help: On hover cards and anywhere else a member is summarised.
